data.name: Blue Whale Expedition
data.headline: Full-day offshore whale-watching expedition from Mission Bay searching for blue whales and other marine mammals.
data.description: Join a long-range blue whale expedition from Mission Bay, San Diego, during peak season (late May–August). The tour explores up to 100 miles offshore in search of blue whales, fin whales, dolphins, sea lions and other marine mammals. Trips run June and July at the season peak and depart at a custom time based on weather and guest preference. Voyages range from four to six hours (note shorter duration applies when three or fewer passengers book), offering expansive ocean time for wildlife encounters and photography.
data.highlights:
* Search up to 100 miles offshore for blue whales and other exotic whale species
* Peak-season departures in June and July for the best blue whale opportunities
* Small-boat experience with a maximum of six guests per boat for a more personalized tour
data.group_size: Max capacity: 6 guests per boat; up to 12 people across two boats

data.booking_notes:
### Boarding Instructions:
Please arrive 15 minutes prior to your boarding time and make sure to fill out your waivers electronically.

## What to Bring
- We suggest you bring a reusable bottle of water lunch and/or snacks.
- It’s always a great idea to bring warm clothing, a sweater and a rain jacket (Layering works wonders) We'll also be under the sun so please bring biodegradable sunscreen, sunglasses and a hat.
- Our Zodiac boat has a low center of gravity minimizing rocking motion. However, If prone to seasickness we recommend you to take the seasickness medicine the night before your expedition and another dose 30 minutes before the trip.
data.check_in_details: Departure and return location: Mission Bay, San Diego, California. Exact departure time is custom and determined by weather forecast and guest preferences.
data.special_requirements: Passengers should be able to tolerate high-speed zodiac travel; trips may be shortened to four hours if three or fewer passengers book.
data.restrictions: Not recommended for people with back or neck problems due to potential rough seas and zodiac speeds.
data.disclaimers: Minimum of two people required to run the trip; single passengers should call to make arrangements. Zodiac cruises at 20+ mph and may encounter unexpected rough seas. Availability: end of May through August. Expedition duration may be limited to four hours when three or fewer passengers book.
